final: SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS average_spent, AVG(remaining) AS average_remaining, AVG(remaining) - (SELECT AVG(event_average_remaining) FROM (SELECT AVG(remaining) AS event_average_remaining FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event)) AS difference_from_mean FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event ORDER BY difference_from_mean IS NULL, difference_from_mean DESC LIMIT 10
